video.title: State of Agentic Coding #8 with Mario, Armin, and Ben

abstract: Armin Ronacher, Ben Vinegar, and Mario Zechner compare the hype around agentic coding with their day-to-day experience using tools like Pi, Claude Code, and Fable. The conversation is valuable because it separates genuine workflow gains from benchmark theater, harness-specific quirks, and the rising economic cost of letting agents run wild.
mainTakeaway: Agentic coding is improving mostly through harnesses, loops, and better orchestration—not through a clean jump in model intelligence—and that means developers still need strict tools, real evals, and skepticism about cost, regressions, and hype. Video Float − + Dock
